people.name: Jashobeam
people.line: Chief of David's mighty men, Hachmoni's son

people.name: Zabdiel
people.line: Father of Jashobeam, commander of David's army

translations.web: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division, which was assigned the first month. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
